title: Comments to DM Config
description: Keyword → DM routing for the GHL Instagram comment-to-DM system. One row per keyword/lead magnet. n8n reads this live: comment containing Keyword → DM Text sent as private reply ({{link}} is replaced with [WEBSITE_DOMAIN]/{Landing Slug}?utm_source=ig&utm_medium=dm&utm_campaign={Landing Slug}). Tag applied is kw-{keyword lowercase}, derived automatically. Only rows with Active checked are matched. Adding a new post/lead magnet = adding one row here. Never reuse a keyword across different lead magnets.
